newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: VILFIMA, DE BROE TO ISSUE ROKISHKIS GDRS.
newsitem.headline: VILFIMA, DE BROE TO ISSUE ROKISHKIS GDRS.

text.p: Lithuanian broker Vilfima said on Thursday that it has signed an agreement with Williams de Broe to issue global depository receipts (GDRs) for Rokishkis Cheese.
"Today we have signed a mandate agreement with Williams de Broe and Rokishkis Cheese on creating a GDR facility and placement," the head of Vilfima brokerage house, Alvydas Zhabolis. told Reuters.
"We will place the whole new issue of 200,000 shares," Zhabolis added.
He also said that the shareholders of the company decided that the issue price of the shares, which have a face value of ten litas, should be no less than 44 litas.
Rokishkis Cheese said earlier that it had decided its current shareholders would have no priority right to buy into the issue.
The current share capital of the company stands at 30.24 million litas.
Williams de Broe has a stake of around 12 percent in the company.
The company produces fermented cheese, whole milk products, butter and milk sugar.
Exports accounted for 75 percent of its sales in 1996.
The company posted an audited net profit of 10.46 million litas and sales of 123.46 million litas in 1996.
The company also said earlier that its net profit in the first four months of the year amounted to 5.9 million litas and the sales in the first five months of the year were 55.8 million litas.
